items.name: Studio
items.description: Manage your artist profile, prepare releases and organise store drafts in one workspace. Studio is included with an active Silver partnership.

items.name: Studio Pro
items.description: For a broader website and business toolkit, according to the services available to your account. Studio Pro is included with an active Gold or Platinum partnership.

comparison.caption: Studio plans
comparison.scopeNotice: Software subscriptions, recording partnerships and store sales have separate terms. Contact Artanrecords about access; online subscription checkout is currently unavailable.

rows.label: Monthly price
rows.details: Monthly prices cover software access. Each plan has its own annual option, shown under Annual. Prices do not change recording revenue shares or store fees. Contact Artanrecords to arrange access; selecting a billing period here does not start a subscription or charge.

rows.label: Annual price
rows.details: Annual billing uses the yearly prices shown, not a monthly rate multiplied by twelve. Compare the two billing options before choosing. Any applicable tax and final amount due must be confirmed before payment. Selecting this tab does not purchase or renew a subscription.

rows.label: Profile and private preparation
rows.details: Current tools support account access, profile management and private release and store drafts. Saving a draft does not distribute music or sell a product. This list-price correction does not retroactively charge accounts, remove data or invent advanced features.

rows.label: Advanced analytics and Store tools
rows.details: Analytics, commerce reporting, exports and team access require their own operational and approved services. A plan name does not mean these tools are live. Product sales, recording income and software subscriptions remain separate commercial systems.

rows.label: Included partnership access
rows.details: Verified active Silver partnerships include Studio; verified active Gold and Platinum partnerships include Studio Pro. Included access does not change the list price or create a separate subscription charge. A requested or approved tier label alone is not evidence of an active signed agreement.

rows.label: Payments and continuation
rows.details: Subscriptions, invoices, renewals and upgrades are not active. Included access follows its verified entitlement dates. No automatic paid conversion or destructive downgrade occurs. Grace periods, cancellation, retention and continuation policies remain to be approved.

includedAccess.title: Access through your partnership
paragraphs: Silver includes Studio. Gold and Platinum include Studio Pro for the duration of the qualifying partnership, with no separate software subscription charge.

When your partnership ends, contact Artanrecords to discuss continued access. Your work is not automatically deleted, and no paid subscription starts without your consent. Recording agreements, software subscriptions and store sales have separate terms.
